prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a lean sea-green fish-man standing upright on two webbed feet, a scaly body with a pale belly, a fish head with big round black eyes and a wide mouth of small teeth, a tall spiny yellow fin crest on its head and down its back, webbed clawed hands holding one long bone trident in the hand on the right side of the image, no armour or clothes. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its fish face with big round black eyes and a wide mouth is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward and stabbing the bone trident at the heroes with both hands, the fin crest raised, the same one trident as in the idle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the fin crest flattened, the mouth gaping, the trident tilted back in the same hand, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight clearly onto one leg, twist the torso and extend the arms and the trident far from the body. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak, scarf or extra cloth, and no slash trail, smear, motion arc or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, armour, a shield, a cape, a crown, a spear, a second trident, a fish tail instead of legs, an anglerfish lure.
